decided: The concepts page now says that a system review of a change with unread decision records also has a clean reader check whether each record makes sense, and that a record found wanting is fixed by a new record that replaces it; the command reference says a record is never edited and how a replacement names the record it replaces.
alternatives: leave the reading step out of the user docs until the program's documentation stage
why: The reading step runs by default, so a user who reads the concepts page should learn why a system review reports findings against decision records and how they are fixed.

defines.definition: a file orbit keeps for each call the AI made that affects the user or security, each time a run needed the user, and each answer the user gave
